segments.source: Informs the delegate that the capture output object emitted new metadata objects.
segments.ko: 캡처 출력 객체가 새 메타데이터 객체를 방출했음을 델리게이트에 알립니다.

segments.source:
```swift
optional func metadataOutput(_ output: AVCaptureMetadataOutput, didOutput metadataObjects: [AVMetadataObject], from connection: AVCaptureConnection)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
optional func metadataOutput(_ output: AVCaptureMetadataOutput, didOutput metadataObjects: [AVMetadataObject], from connection: AVCaptureConnection)
```

segments.source: The [`AVCaptureMetadataOutput`](avcapturemetadataoutput.md) object emits only metadata objects whose types are included in its [`metadataObjectTypes`](avcapturemetadataoutput/metadataobjecttypes.md) property.
segments.ko: The [`AVCaptureMetadataOutput`](avcapturemetadataoutput.md) object emits only metadata objects whose types are included in its [`metadataObjectTypes`](avcapturemetadataoutput/metadataobjecttypes.md) property.

segments.source: The delegate implements this method to perform additional processing on metadata objects as they become available.
segments.ko: The delegate implements this method to perform additional processing on metadata objects as they become available.

segments.source: If you plan to use metadata objects outside the scope of this method, you must store strong references to them and remove those references when the objects are no longer required.
segments.ko: 이 메서드 범위 외부에서 메타데이터 객체를 사용할 계획이라면 해당 객체에 대한 강한 참조를 보유하고, 더 이상 필요하지 않을 때 그 참조를 제거해야 합니다.

segments.source: This method is executed on the dispatch queue specified by the [`metadataObjectsCallbackQueue`](avcapturemetadataoutput/metadataobjectscallbackqueue.md) property of the capture metadata output object.
segments.ko: This method is executed on the dispatch queue specified by the [`metadataObjectsCallbackQueue`](avcapturemetadataoutput/metadataobjectscallbackqueue.md) property of the capture metadata output object.

segments.source: Because this method may be called frequently, your implementation should be efficient to prevent capture performance problems, including dropped metadata objects.
segments.ko: Because this method may be called frequently, your implementation should be efficient to prevent capture performance problems, including dropped metadata objects.

segments.source: `output`: The [`AVCaptureMetadataOutput`](avcapturemetadataoutput.md) object that captured and emitted the metadata objects.

`metadataObjects`: An array of [`AVMetadataObject`](avmetadataobject.md) instances representing the newly emitted metadata. Because [`AVMetadataObject`](avmetadataobject.md) is an abstract class, the objects in this array are always instances of a concrete subclass.
segments.ko: `metadataObjects`: 새로 방출된 메타데이터를 나타내는 [`AVMetadataObject`](avmetadataobject.md) 인스턴스의 배열입니다. [`AVMetadataObject`](avmetadataobject.md)은 추상 클래스이므로 이 배열의 객체는 항상 구체적 하위 클래스의 인스턴스입니다.

segments.source: `connection`: The capture connection through which the objects were emitted.
